# Prompt Snippets for DSH
简体中文
[](https://github.com/dadazhangn/dsh-prompt-snippets/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.
com/package/dsh-prompt-snippets) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-prompt-snippets) [](https://op
ensource.org/licenses/MIT)
**Stop retyping the prompts you use every day.** Save them once, fill in the changing details, and i
nsert them into the DSH composer in a click. If it saves you time, star the repository or share it w
ith another DSH user.
Prompt Snippets is a local-first prompt library for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Organize reusable prompt
s with categories, tags, and favorites; use `{{placeholders}}` for project-specific details; and fin
d the right snippet from a searchable panel or keyboard shortcut.
> **Your prompts stay on your device.** Snippets are stored in your local DSH data directory. Nothin
g is sent to a server unless you choose **AI Optimize**, which sends the selected snippet to the mod
el service configured in DSH.
## See how it works

1. Save a prompt such as `Review this code for {{language}} bugs: {{code}}`.
2. Search your library

and click the snippet you need.
3. Fill in its variables; the completed prompt goes straight into th

he snippet you need.
3. Fill in its variables; the completed prompt goes straight into the composer.
The panel supports browsing, editing, and organizing your snippets without leaving the conversation.
For a quick lookup, press **Ctrl+Shift+K** and search from anywhere.
Use **↑/↓** to choose a snippet and **Enter** to open its placeholder form. In the form, **Tab / Shi
ft+Tab** moves between fields, **Ctrl+Enter** inserts and sends, and **Esc** closes it. If a require
d field is empty, **Ctrl+Enter** focuses the first missing field instead.
## Install
### From the DSH plugin store
Find **Prompt Snippets** in the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog. The catalog entry points to this GitHub
repository, so it installs the repository version.
### With DSH
Install the published npm package:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `web` with the profile you use. After installation, restart DSH and reload the page. The **📋
Snippets** button appears in the composer toolbar.
### From GitHub
To install the latest repository code directly:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
GitHub installs follow the repository; npm installs follow the published package version. For local
development, install a checkout with `dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:/path/to/dsh-prompt-snippe
lopment, install a checkout with `dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:/path/to/dsh-prompt-snippets`.
**Requirements:** DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3`.
## Try it
Create a reusable code-review prompt. `/snippet add` uses the first word as the name, so use a hyphe
e code-review prompt. `/snippet add` uses the first word as the name, so use a hyphen between words:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then click **📋 Snippets** beside the composer, choose **Review-code**, fill in `language` and `code`
, and insert the finished prompt. You can also create and edit snippets directly in the panel, where
names may contain spaces.
Useful commands:
| Command | What it does |

| `/snippet list` | List saved snippets |
| `/snippet add <name> <content>` | Create or update a sni

ppet |
| `/snippet show <name>` | View a snippet and its revision |
| `/snippet pin <name-or-id>` |

Pin a favorite to the top |
| `/snippet tag <name-or-id> <tags>` | Add searchable tags |
| `/snippet

optimize <name>` | Open an AI-assisted rewrite for review |
| `/snippet export [file]` | Export sni

ppets to JSON |
| `/snippet import <file>` | Import snippets from JSON |
Commands that treat the remaining input as a name accept spaces. `/snippet add` and `/snippet tag` u
se the first word as the name; use a hyphen or underscore for multiword names in those commands, or
create them in the panel. If a name collides, commands report candidates so you can select the inten
in the panel. If a name collides, commands report candidates so you can select the intended snippet.
## Why use it?
- **Get to the prompt quickly.** Search by name, category, tag, or content. Use the floating library

or the global keyboard palette; favorites appear first.
- **Reuse a template without editing it eve
ry time.** Add `{{variables}}` and fill them in when inserting. Optional defaults, required fields,

dropdown choices, and `{{date}}`, `{{time}}`, and `{{datetime}}` are supported.
- **Keep useful prom
pts organized.** Add categories and tags, pin favorites, sort by recent use, and revisit earlier ver

sions.
- **Stay in control of AI rewrites.** Compare the original with the generated draft, edit the
draft, then choose whether to insert it or replace the saved snippet. Rewrites never overwrite a sn

ippet automatically.
- **Keep your library portable.** Import and export JSON backups. Data is store
d locally, with atomic writes and recoverable backups.
## AI Optimize
AI Optimize is optional and uses the default model configured in DSH. It streams a proposed rewrite
into a comparison view; the original stays intact until you choose an action.

- **Insert optimized** puts the reviewed draft into the composer and leaves the library unchanged.
-
**Replace snippet content** saves the reviewed draft. The action is disabled if the result is incom

plete, over the size limit, or missing an original placeholder.
- **Retry** requests a fresh rewrite
. You can edit the generated draft before using it.
The selected snippet is sent to your configured model service only when you start this action. Other
library operations do not send snippet content to an external service.
## Data and recovery
The library is stored at `<DSH_HOME>/data/prompt-snippets/snippets.json`. If `DSH_HOME` is unset, DS
tored at `<DSH_HOME>/data/prompt-snippets/snippets.json`. If `DSH_HOME` is unset, DSH uses `~/.dsh`.
Writes use a temporary file and atomic replacement. Previous data is retained in rotating `.bak` fil
es; malformed data is preserved as a recovery copy. Deletion is reversible, and each snippet keeps u
p to 20 prior versions. Import supports merge, replace, and dry-run modes.
